IGUI_TraditionalPreservationYeast_CakesS: Spent cakes won't dry into yeast.
IGUI_TraditionalPreservationYeast_ShelfL: Before factory yeast, bakers bought barm, the froth skimmed off fermenting ale, from the brewery down the road, or kept a starter of their own going and fed it.
IGUI_TraditionalPreservationYeast_NoteDr: Drag Fermenting or Fed Cultures onto the jars to put them on.
IGUI_TraditionalPreservationYeast_BandEm: make Fermenting Culture (Cooking) and put it on
IGUI_TraditionalPreservationYeast_BandLo: %1 of %2 jars gone off or Spent
IGUI_TraditionalPreservationYeast_BandDo: every jar is ready: take them
IGUI_TraditionalPreservationYeast_NoneDo: None done yet: the next in %1.
None done yet, and none is working now (hungry, or too cold).
IGUI_TraditionalPreservationYeast_Nothin: No Fermenting Culture on the shelf needs feeding.
IGUI_TraditionalPreservationYeast_Refres: Each jar takes %1 use of flour and %2 of water: you have no flour in reach.
Each jar takes %1 use of flour and %2 of water: you carry no water.
Feeds every Fermenting Culture on the shelf: %1 use of flour and %2 of water a jar, the hungriest first if there isn't enough. Hungry now: %3.
IGUI_TraditionalPreservationYeast_PutHel: A Fermenting Culture wants refreshing about once a day at a good temperature. A Fed Culture rises in a day and needs nothing.
IGUI_TraditionalPreservationYeast_TakeAl: A culture taken off before it is done comes back as it was, and keeps going hungry off the shelf; one gone off comes back as its empty jar.
IGUI_TraditionalPreservationYeast_NotACu: Only Fermenting and Fed Cultures go on the shelf.
IGUI_TraditionalPreservationYeast_NoteRe: A Fermenting Culture goes hungry %1 hours of work after its last feed, and off after %2. Warm, that is a day and three; cold, longer. Off the shelf it goes on getting hungry.
